content.short: Sygnum Web3 Recovery provides Safe account wallet recovery to support reliable self-custody.
content.description: The platform delivers a wallet recovery solution for Safe accounts, making self-custody recovery dependable, fast to set up, and easy to use even for non-technical users. Sygnum, a regulated Swiss bank focused on digital assets, aims to help everyone securely own crypto with true confidence. The service provides Safe account recovery for all digital asset holders—from large institutions to individual users—and is built to meet regulatory compliance and KYC requirements.
content.meta: Sygnum Web3 Recovery provides Safe account wallet recovery for self-custody. Discover Sygnum Web3 Recovery and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
